records.add_note: The source aligns bʌbɐː with 'my' in the cry 'Oh no! It’s a tiger!'; possessive-pronoun versus interjection analysis is not independently established.
records.decision: Keep the source my gloss but do not force possessive pronoun or case from the English exclamation.

explicit_nondecisions: English quantifiers all/many/some do not by themselves license num or a morphological analysis.
went-I/started-they/etc. remain whole printed aligned tokens, not segmented pronouns.
Question-shaped compounds what-is-it and context-heavy clauses are not automatically split into POS units.
No grammatical class inferred for pause, emph, or source-misaligned C5n1 was/small pair.
